items.title: ChatGPT Ads New Call-To-Actions, Business Agents Expand, More Audience Metrics & More
items.excerpt: OpenAI's ChatGPT Ads product update: Business Agents expand outside the U.S., a new 'learn more' CTA on single-image ads, more audience metrics in Ads Manager and the Ads API, an option to hide product-feed sale prices after a promotion ends, and new policy changes.
items.rationale: New ChatGPT Ads release (reach/frequency metrics, CTA, Business Agents outside US) that changes how buyers report and build ads; single pick for the SER/PPC Land/SEJ cluster.

items.title: AI Agent Traffic to Surge 150x This Cyber Week, Driven Mostly by Meta Muse
items.excerpt: New data forecasts AI-agent traffic to retail sites surging 150x over Cyber Week, with Meta's Muse personal assistant accounting for the vast majority of agent-led site requests.
items.rationale: Fresh Cyber Week forecast quantifying agent-led retail traffic; the only Muse-centric marketing item, and it is new data, not the Walmart/Amazon/UK Muse stories.

items.title: In Graphic Detail: How shoppers are adopting AI for product research ahead of Black Friday
items.excerpt: Data on how shoppers use AI chatbots for product discovery ahead of Black Friday, leaving marketers unsure how to shift spend and tactics for the biggest sales period of the year.
items.rationale: Shopper-adoption data tied directly to holiday spend allocation decisions; distinct dataset from previously carded Salesforce/Clarity studies.

items.title: "10만원 이하 난방기 찾아줘"…다나와, 챗GPT로 AI 쇼핑 확대
items.excerpt: Danawa connected live product and price data to ChatGPT via an MCP service after Claude; 74% of its generative-AI-referred traffic already comes from ChatGPT.
items.rationale: Concrete Korean commerce launch putting live price/product data into ChatGPT via MCP, with a hard traffic figure; adds Korean-market and outlet diversity.

items.title: IAB Europe gives publishers a 90-day plan for AI bots, deals and ads
items.excerpt: IAB Europe's agentic-web playbook has publishers score 12 areas out of 36 points, set rules for seven AI uses and weigh six ways to charge AI agents and bots, with no prices given.
items.rationale: New industry-body release on how sell-side handles AI agents, deals and ad monetisation; trade-standard document, distinct from the IAB US attribution blueprint (11-14).
